summary.text: John Fitzgerald is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives from District 83 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Born in Lansing, he works in insurance and has served on the Wyoming city council.

paragraphs.text: Fitzgerald was born in Lansing, Michigan, and earned a bachelor's degree from Michigan State University in 2013.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he and his wife moved to West Michigan in 2014, that he had served on the boards of Ele's Place West Michigan, Ele's Place Michigan and the Clark Foundation, and that his professional background is in commercial property and liability insurance.
He said he was elected to the Wyoming City Council as a member at-large in 2020.
In the 2025-2026 session Fitzgerald is minority vice chair of the House Government Operations Committee and serves on the Insurance Committee.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Cindy Ramirez in the general election on November 3, 2026.
In the 2022 survey, he listed economic development, strengthening public education and community safety among his key messages.
